original_ai_output.title_zh: 评论：南苏丹需要无畏的领导——以卡利斯托·拉多为例
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一篇评论文章称，南苏丹需要敢于直面不公、为普通民众发声的领导者，并以朱巴县看守专员卡利斯托·拉多·福斯蒂诺·尼吉洛为例。文章回顾了他2021年任朱巴市长、2024年3月据称因谴责土地掠夺而被捕、约五个月后于2024年9月6日获释，以及2026年10月2日宣誓就任朱巴县看守专员的经历。文章还提到人权组织对其拘留情况的关切。

key_facts.fact: 评论文章称南苏丹需要敢于直面不公、为普通民众发声的领导者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan needs leaders who are not afraid to stand up for what is right, confront injustice and speak for ordinary citizens

key_facts.fact: 卡利斯托·拉多于2021年3月出任朱巴市长，约八个月后于2021年11月被解职
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In March 2021, he became Mayor of Juba... During his approximately eight-month tenure... his dismissal in November 2021 prompted petitions

key_facts.fact: 据报他于2024年3月发表谴责土地掠夺的讲话后被捕，安全人员据称于3月30日将其从家中带走
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in March 2024, when he was reportedly arrested after delivering a speech condemning land-grabbing practices... Security personnel reportedly took him from his home on 30 March

key_facts.fact: 人权观察称其被单独隔离关押且未经法庭审理即获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Human Rights Watch subsequently reported that he had been held incommunicado and released without being presented in court

key_facts.fact: 他于2024年9月6日获释，此前被关押约五个月
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kalisto was released on 6 September 2024, after approximately five months in detention

key_facts.fact: 他于2026年10月2日宣誓就任朱巴县看守专员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: His return to public administration as Caretaker Commissioner of Juba County, following his swearing-in on 2 October 2026

uncertainties: 其2024年3月被捕及被安全人员带走的说法为据报，尚未获独立证实
